name: khmer-phonetic-keyboard
description: Type Khmer by sound. A phonetic Khmer keyboard as a web app, and as a Keyman package for Android, iOS and Windows.

scripts.build:packages: kmc build keyman/pakrinha.km.khmerphonetic/pakrinha.km.khmerphonetic.kpj --no-error-reporting && kmc build keyman/khmer_phonetic/khmer_phonetic.kpj --no-error-reporting -m KM0209A
scripts.build: npm run build:keyman && npm run build:wordlist && npm run build:docs && npm run build:packages && node tools/collect_dist.mjs

author: Keang Pakrinha
